key_sentences: Thank you for your letter of 18 February about the water pressure at your warehouse on Quarry Road.
We have reviewed the readings from the meter on your site and from the two nearest pumping stations.
Our engineers found that a valve on the main supply line had been left partly closed after repairs in January.
The valve was fully reopened on 27 February, and the pressure at your meter has been normal since that day.
We apologise for the inconvenience this caused to your business.
As a gesture of goodwill, we will credit your account with one month of standing charges.
The credit will appear on your next quarterly bill, which is due at the end of April.
If you notice any further drop in pressure, please call our service desk on 0190 555 0142.
We will send a technician within one working day.
notes: Business letter, one page. Sender block (3 lines), date, recipient block (4 lines), salutation, four body paragraphs, closing and a 2-line signature.
